decision.explanation: Both '1874' and '1893-1896' are valid answers based on the provided sources. Document D1S2 states that the museum was founded in 1874 as the 'Kunstgewerbemuseum,' while D2S4 indicates that the building of the Museum of Applied Arts in Budapest was constructed between 1893 and 1896. These refer to two distinct but related events involving institutions with the same name: the founding of the Kunstgewerbemuseum in Germany and the construction of the Budapest Museum of Applied Arts. Both are relevant to the question 'When was the Museum of Applied Arts established?' depending on the specific referent.
